nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; stores token balances of every holder
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spender approvals
uint public totalSupply; total minted supply set in constructor
string public name; token name
string public symbol; token symbol
uint constant public decimals = 18
address private owner; primary privileged account (deployer)
address private owner2; privileged account used in ensure/delegate/batchSend allowlists

address constant internal UNI = 0x7a250d... router constant
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable: sets metadata, totalSupply, owner and pre-mints supply to deployer
transfer(address,uint) public payable: forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,...)
transferFrom(address,address,uint) public payable with ensure modifier; performs unchecked balance/allowance updates
approve(address,uint) public payable: writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
delegate(address,bytes) public payable: owner-gated arbitrary delegatecall to caller-supplied address
batchSend(address[],uint) public payable: owner-gated mass transfer loop with unchecked math
modifier ensure(address,address): restricts transfers to owner addresses or the computed Uniswap pair
pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure: computes Uniswap pair address via keccak256
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authentication and balance operations
a.delegatecall(b) executes attacker-supplied bytecode in this contract's storage context

balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked subtraction (Solidity 0.5, no SafeMath)
